control_expectations_before_run.AcceptancePilot: Damage-stage Missile, maximal attacks/blocks, pass priority, first Sneak cast, keep scry order.
control_expectations_before_run.PassingPilot: Pass/no attackers/no blocks/no sneak/all scry cards bottom; misses non-pass T/R obligations.

execution_interpretation.boundary: Compare returned supplied option to sealed empty/pass-only or empty-scry predicate; domain contradictions remain flagged.
execution_interpretation.exceptions: Every scheduled hook is invoked once; exceptions are recorded as no return, never repaired or retried.
execution_interpretation.hq_decision: PENDING; per-call comparisons do not certify fixture validity or suite fitness.
execution_interpretation.main_stage: damage for frozen Missile witness and main boundary; explicit hook argument absent from candidate JSON.
execution_interpretation.permutation: Reverse complete supplied option tuple, preserving membership.
execution_interpretation.rename: Bijection of sorted runtime IDs to object-900000 onwards; same map for oracle.
execution_interpretation.seal_limits: Seal digests certify canonical data/normalization; variant instances are reconstructed here, not claimed as preserved serialized states.
execution_interpretation.seats: Structural player-index mirror of sealed observations and option identities.
